index-100.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT p.category,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, month,
  100 * revenue / FIRST_VALUE(revenue) OVER (
    PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month
  ) AS indexed
FROM m
ORDER BY category, month;
focus: PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month

ranking.sql:
WITH cr AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.country,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country
)
SELECT name, country, revenue,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS overall,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC
  ) AS in_country
FROM cr
ORDER BY overall;
focus: PARTITION BY country ORDER BY revenue

bins.sql:
WITH ov AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS v
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT FLOOR(v / 250) * 250 AS bin,  -- 250 from the menu
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(v) AS revenue
FROM ov
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

targets.sql:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE c.country IN ('Japan')  -- from the Country filter
    AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), tgt AS (
  SELECT SUM(monthly_target) AS target
  FROM countries
  WHERE name IN ('Japan')  -- the same filter, again
)
SELECT month, revenue, target,
  revenue / target AS attainment
FROM rev CROSS JOIN tgt
ORDER BY month;

what-if.sql:
SELECT p.category,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS actual,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price * CASE p.category
    WHEN 'Software' THEN 1.10  -- spliced in from the preset
    WHEN 'Services' THEN 1.05
    ELSE 1 END) AS scenario
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

cohort-from-rank.sql:
WITH cr AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
), dec AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS decile
  FROM cr
)
SELECT p.category,
  d.decile = 1 AS top_10pct,  -- 10% picked by the reader
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN dec d ON d.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

bookmarks.sql:
-- rebuilt from {"country": "Japan", "from": "2026-04-01",
--   "grain": "week", "sort": "revenue", "utc_offset": 9}
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week',
    o.ordered_ts + INTERVAL '9 hours') AS week,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Japan'
  AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue

refresh.sql:
-- the freshness line
SELECT MAX(ordered_at) AS data_as_of,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS ran_at,
  MD5(COUNT(*) || ':' || MAX(id)) AS cache_key
FROM orders;

-- Refresh: a new nonce so no cache layer can match it
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE 1760606400 > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

trend-line.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue,
    MAX(o.ordered_at) AS last_day
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
), idx AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) - 1 AS x,
    last_day::DATE = LAST_DAY(month) AS is_full
  FROM m
)
SELECT REGR_SLOPE(revenue, x) AS per_month,
  REGR_INTERCEPT(revenue, x) AS start
FROM idx
-- leave out the latest month if it isn't over yet
WHERE is_full OR month < (SELECT MAX(month) FROM idx);
